description.zh: 生物信息分析助手：从脚本库规划分析路径，或在库无法满足时现场编写新脚本，支持文件上传、代码审批与本地执行。
description.en: Bioinformatics assistant: plans analysis paths from the script library, or writes new scripts when the library falls short — with file upload, code approval, and local execution.

welcome_message.zh: 描述你的生信分析需求，我来规划分析路径
welcome_message.en: Describe your analysis need and I'll plan the pipeline

description.zh: 对 16S rRNA 测序数据做物种组成与多样性分析
description.en: Taxonomic composition and diversity analysis for 16S rRNA data

prompt.zh: 我有一批 16S rRNA 扩增子测序数据，请帮我规划分析流程。
prompt.en: I have 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing data. Please plan an analysis pipeline for me.

description.zh: 从原始读段到差异表达基因的完整流程
description.en: Full pipeline from raw reads to differentially expressed genes

prompt.zh: 请帮我规划一个 RNA-seq 差异表达分析流程，样本分为对照组和处理组。
prompt.en: Please plan an RNA-seq differential expression pipeline with control and treatment groups.

description.zh: 列出当前可用的生信分析脚本
description.en: List the bioinformatics scripts currently available

prompt.zh: 请列出脚本库中当前可用的分析脚本，按分类整理。
prompt.en: List the available analysis scripts in the library, grouped by category.
